title: reproduce and fix a real defect from a vague report
disclosure: the agent is told nothing beyond the ticket; no stack trace, no reproduction, no file pointer

procedure: copy every file under tests/ from the agent worktree into <tmp>
require at least one line beginning 'FAIL:'
require at least one FAIL: line to name a test absent from baseline_test_functions
run repo_suite in the agent worktree and require exit 0
two_revision_check.fail_when: the new test passes on pre-fix, or only errors there, or no test was added

grades.check: the agent's new test fails by assertion at pre-fix
grades.fail_when: it passes at pre-fix, or it only raises a collection/import error there, or no new test exists

grades.check: repo_suite exits 0 in the agent worktree
grades.fail_when: the agent's own suite is red after the fix
duplicates still occur through ContactStore.save or the web form, or distinct people are collapsed

grades.check: grade_lib.detect_test_weakening(baseline, after) is empty and detect_tautologies(after) is empty
grades.fail_when: a pre-existing test was removed, skipped, or lost assertions

grades.check: the duplicate no longer occurs when ContactStore.save is called directly
grades.fail_when: only the web-form caller was patched while the store still duplicates

notes_only: whether the agent explained why the nightly import never showed the bug
unproven_when: git worktree is unavailable on the host, so the pre-fix run could not be made
